videos.title: Cardistry Bootcamp | Twirls & Flirts - Ventus Tutorial by Tien Tran
videos.description:
Today, we have our Vietnamese friend Tien Tran (also known as Zomb Tien) teaching his move Ventus. That name though. Anyway, to find more of Tien's material you can follow him on Instagram or subscribe to his Youtube channel. Both of them are linked below. 

Though this move itself is not a card twirl or flirt, the move utilizes a lot of twirls so we put it under this category. Once you get this move down you will be able to apply these flirts to create your own combos. Learning this move will also give you an understanding of what kind of wrist and hand motions enhance the effect of a twirl.

videos.description:
Leporidae
Difficulty: Intermediate 

Leporidae is a unique looking cut that bounces from left to right with a smooth flow.

Leporidae is the family of mammals which includes the rabbits and hares. This flourish is meant to bounce side to side like the Leporidae. 

I came up with Leporidae in mid 2014. I had been playing with the opening sequence for some time before finally getting the flow of the middle and closer.
